title: Beyond the Coast: an Empirical Assessment of the Kaldor-Verdoorn Law in Chinese Provinces
abstract: arXiv:2609.37051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper investigates spatial productivity convergence across Chinese provinces during structural transformation, examining how a shift in auonomous demand composition reshaped regional productivity dynamics. Using Panel Structural Vector Autoregressive modelling and province level data from 2001 to 2021, we analyse eastern, central, ad western regions across two sub-periods through the augmented Kaldor-Verdoorn law. A post-2011 spatial reversal emerges: inland regions exhibit stronger Verdoorn coefficients, while fiscal multipliers converge across coastal and inland areas, validating China's redistributive fiscal policies in narrowing regional productivity gaps. The Kaldor-Verdoorn coefficient remains robust throughout, while export effects on productivity collapse and government expenditure effects strenghten.

translated_title: 超越沿海：中国省域卡尔多-维多恩定律的实证评估
translated_abstract: 本文研究了中国各省份在结构转型期间的空间生产率收敛问题，考察了自主需求构成的转变如何重塑区域生产率动态。利用面板结构向量自回归（Panel SVAR）模型和2001年至2021年的省级数据，我们通过扩展的卡尔多-维多恩定律，对东部、中部和西部地区在两个子时期的表现进行了分析。研究发现，2011年后出现了空间逆转：内陆地区表现出更强的维多恩系数，而财政乘数在沿海与内陆地区之间趋于收敛，这验证了中国再分配性财政政策在缩小区域生产率差距方面的有效性。卡尔多-维多恩系数在整个研究期间保持稳健，而出口对生产率的影响大幅减弱，政府支出的影响则显著增强。
tldr: 该研究基于2001-2021年中国省级面板结构向量自回归模型，发现2011年后内陆地区的维多恩系数超越沿海地区且财政乘数趋于收敛，验证了中国再分配性财政政策有效缩小了区域生产率差距，同时出口效应减弱而政府支出效应增强。
en_tdlr: Using Panel SVAR modelling on Chinese provincial data (2001-2021), this study reveals a post-2011 spatial reversal in which inland regions exhibit stronger Verdoorn coefficients and converging fiscal multipliers, validating China's redistributive fiscal policies in narrowing regional productivity gaps.
